editorContract.inlineRangeEvidence: findings/evidence/f078-inline-format-on-a-selection/ -- all four inline formats measured on both range shapes against the shipped artifact f923cfa5, the formatted text equal to the selected text in every arm, with a baseline save and a shipped-profile control.
